# PlainSignal - Google Analytics Alternative, Cookie-free, privacy-focused simple website analytics

> Cookie-free, privacy-focused, privacy-friendly simple website analytics with built-in web vitals. EU hosted, GDPR, CCPA and PECR compliant analytics. Lightweight Google Analytics alternative.
